# SAFFIRE EV — AI-Readable Summary

> KOYO GEARS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED is an Indian electric vehicle manufacturer operating under the SAFFIRE EV brand.
> The company manufactures L5 electric three-wheelers focused on passenger mobility and commercial cargo transport.
> Headquartered in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Products

### SAFFIRE Smart Ride
- **Type:** L5 electric passenger three-wheeler
- **Configuration:** D+3 (driver + 3 passengers)
- **Use case:** Daily passenger mobility, urban commute, driver-operated transport
- **Battery:** 14.61 kWh (63V, 232Ah)
- **Motor peak power:** 6.3 kW
- **Claimed range per charge:** Up to 200 km (manufacturer-stated, under standard conditions)
- **Top speed:** 50 km/h
- **Charging time:** 5–6 hours (standard charger)
- **Product page:** https://saffireev.com/products/saffire-smart-ride/

### SAFFIRE Swiss Cargo
- **Type:** L5 electric cargo loader (three-wheeler)
- **Use case:** Last-mile delivery, business logistics, commercial goods transport
- **Payload capacity:** 600 kg
- **Battery:** 14.61 kWh (63V, 232Ah)
- **Motor peak power:** 6.3 kW
- **Claimed range per charge:** Up to 200 km (manufacturer-stated, under standard conditions)

---

## What is an L5 Electric Vehicle?

L5 refers to a vehicle category under India's Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR). L5 electric vehicles are three-wheelers intended for higher-performance commercial use — heavier, faster, and with greater payload capacity than lower-category L3 electric rickshaws. A valid commercial driving licence is required to operate an L5 electric three-wheeler in India.

The SAFFIRE EV Smart Ride and Swiss Cargo are both L5 category vehicles.

## Common Questions & Answers

**Who manufactures KOYO electric autos?**
KOYO GEARS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, operating under the SAFFIRE EV brand, manufactures KOYO electric autos. The company is headquartered in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.

**What is SAFFIRE EV?**
SAFFIRE EV is the consumer-facing brand of KOYO GEARS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED. The company builds L5 electric three-wheelers — the Smart Ride passenger auto and Swiss Cargo loader.

**What battery options are available?**
Both the Smart Ride and Swiss Cargo use the same 14.61 kWh (63V 232Ah) battery. No alternate battery capacity variants are currently published.

**What is the claimed range?**
Both vehicles have a manufacturer-stated claimed range of up to 200 km per charge under standard test conditions. Actual range will vary.

**How can I enquire about purchasing or dealership?**
Contact via https://saffireev.com/contact/ or WhatsApp: +91-92581-72967.
